	// Triangle 2D functions 

	// Signed shoelace area: positive for counter-clockwise winding
	Area(t: Triangle2D): Number => (t.A.X * (t.B.Y - t.C.Y) + t.B.X * (t.C.Y - t.A.Y) + t.C.X * (t.A.Y - t.B.Y)).Half;
